purpose: Sources used to evaluate spatial representation, project-boundary assignment and structural urban support.

sources.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística e Informática (INEI), served by MINAM GeoServidor
sources.published_scope: Límite de los distritos de Lima Metropolitana (INEI, 2017)
limitations: Accepted for project-boundary and representation analysis; it does not select district as the final model unit.
A newer official boundary may replace it only after equivalent coverage and identifiers are verified.
The layer is a 2021 structural snapshot and is not a time-varying exposure source.
Intersection with zoning support must not be interpreted as measured pedestrian or traffic exposure.
The layer must not be used as a risk denominator, outcome label or substitute for direct exposure.
The source geometry contains an extra ArcGIS ordinate; the pipeline deterministically normalizes to XY before geometric analysis.
